name: What should I prepare before starting a renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a renovation project, it's beneficial to have a clear idea of your goals, budget, and desired style. Gather inspiration, create a list of must-haves versus nice-to-haves, and consider how the renovation will impact your daily life. Also, ensure you have a designated area for materials and a plan for minimizing disruption. This preparation helps streamline the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before renovating, define your goals, budget, style, and essential needs, and plan for material storage and disruption minimization.
